external_deps: Claude Code or compatible coding assistant

review.tagline: Skill that makes coding assistants answer action-first with numbered steps
review.summary: A skill/plugin for coding assistants such as Claude Code that rewrites response style around 10 rules: lead with the next action, number multi-step tasks, cap lists at 5 items, give time estimates in minutes, and drop preambles, recaps and closers. Behavior is defined in skills/i-have-adhd/SKILL.md, and you can fork and edit that file, then reinstall your copy through the plugin marketplace commands.
review.audience: Coding-assistant users who want terse, action-first, numbered replies
strengths: Behavior lives in one editable SKILL.md with 10 explicit rules
Before/after example shows the exact output change
Install is a single prompt pasted into the assistant
MIT licensed; README translated into 10 languages
weaknesses: Only changes response style; adds no tools or capabilities
Tune-it steps shown only for Claude Code plugin commands
No evidence offered that it improves outcomes beyond one example
needs: Needs Claude Code or compatible coding assistant
